name: disaster-recovery-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal disaster recovery actions based on failure scenarios, system state, and historical recovery outcomes

options.description: Restore system from most recent backup
Fail over to replicated standby system
Perform manual repair of affected components
Roll back to previous known-good version
Rebuild and redeploy system from scratch

evaluation_factors: Type and scope of failure scenario
Current system state including backup age and replication status
Historical success rates for each recovery action in similar situations
Time sensitivity and impact on users during recovery process
Data loss potential with different recovery approaches
